annotations.title: Israeli date facts for one day (or now)

description: Everything about one civil day in Israel: Hebrew date (and the one after sunset), holidays, fasts and national days as kept in Israel (with legal postponements), the weekly parasha (Israel), whether it is an official rest day and a business day, whether schools are closed (Ministry of Education), and optionally candle lighting / havdalah / sunrise / sunset for a city. Without a date: now in Israel (Asia/Jerusalem) and the Hebrew date in force. Each answer has answer_he / answer_en to quote and a status: computed, official (published list), statutory (law, list not yet published), unknown, estimate.

city.description: City id for times, e.g. jerusalem, tel-aviv, haifa, beer-sheva, eilat (see the calendar page for all 24)
